SUP experience on Lake Naguri is a healing eco-tour where you can enjoy the changing seasons and the tranquility of the lake with your whole body—gentle on heart and body.

【Fee】
¥4,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, SUP board rental, etc.)

【Capacity】
5 people

【Guide】
Naguri Canoe Workshop (certified NPO) staff

【What to bring】
Towel, change of clothes, water shoes if needed (barefoot is also fine)

【Note】
Naguri Canoe Workshop (certified NPO) website: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
